# Pre-existing brand-token debt, frozen at v7.3.5.
# Each line is a locale+key whose translation drops a [[brand token]] that the
# English string carries. Effect: on a white-labelled install those strings show
# the wrong product name (or none), because the token that would be substituted
# is absent from the translation. Nearly all of these are STALE translations --
# they translate an older English string that predated the v6.8.0 tokenization.
